title: Van Veen, Barachant & Andreev 2012 — Building Brain Invaders: EEG data of an experimental validation (BI2012)
description: EEG recordings from 25 healthy volunteers playing Brain Invaders, a visual P300 brain-computer interface inspired by the video game Space Invaders. Data were recorded with 16 electrodes at GIPSA-lab (Grenoble, France) in 2012, using a training-test design with Target and NonTarget flashes. This version is a MOABB-derived BIDS conversion of the original Zenodo deposit.
methods_description: EEG was recorded from 16 wet Ag/AgCl electrodes with a NeXus-32 amplifier (MindMedia/TMSi) at 128 Hz, using OpenVibe and a hardware common average reference. Each subject completed a training session (8 Targets, 8 repetitions each, 128 Target and 640 non-Target flashes) and an online session with three levels of distractor configuration. Stimuli were 36 aliens flashing in 12 groups of 6, with a 1:5 Target to non-Target ratio.
